elements.helpInnerText:
This is a sample for introductory and debugging purposes. It is updated periodically so check "Get Blank Form" to get the latest!

        Version 2019120201 adds:
            - Likert widget

        Version 2019061302 adds:
            - Myanmar calendar
            - Persian calendar

        Version 2019020201 adds:
            - Appearance rating for range type

        Version 2018102901 adds:
            - Bikram Sambat calendar

        Version 2018081601 adds:
            - Rank widget

        Version 2018051401 adds:
            - File widget

        Version 2018032801 adds:
            - Appearance new-front (selfie) for video type

        Version 2018022001 adds:
            - Appearance image-map for select\_one and select\_multiple types
            - Appearance new for image, audio, video types

        Version 2017121301 added:
            - Appearance thousands-sep for numeric types
            - Range questions
            - Ethiopian, coptic and islamic calendars
